authorization: User: Do them sequentially. Confirm W02 with the proposed 10 ms allowance, measure P07 plus W02 together if it qualifies, and promote the verified winner.
ttft_rule: For W02 and combined profiles, every candidate launch median must be at most 10 ms slower than every control launch median. Fixed absolute ceiling; never inflate it using drift. P07-only retains the original relative regression rule.
gain_rule: Unchanged: no fixed minimum percent; positive gain strictly above twice own control drift, and both candidate launch medians beat both controls. Average the two launch medians per arm. No statistical significance claim.
other_guards: Unchanged generation/reply regression floors, exact fresh/warmup/cached outputs, healthy monitor, zero new swap, memory gate, actual feature encoding receipts. Cached diagnostic losses block promotion.
sequence: Fresh W02 short screen, then one fresh independent short confirmation only if screen qualifies generation and reply on both English tasks.
If both W02 brackets qualify, test P07 plus W02 against original m5-copy/conv-direct, short English cohort.
If combined qualifies generation and reply, compare combined against P07 alone in a fresh short ABBA to establish whether stacking adds repeatable benefit.
Candidate winner is combined only if its incremental bracket also qualifies generation and reply. Otherwise retain previously confirmed P07. No alternative combinations or performance retries.

Test selected winner against original control on long English prompts and short 32-token answers. Safety brackets need clean resources/output/cache and no material generation/reply/TTFT regressions, rather than a claim of new gains.
If combined fails a safety bracket, test the predefined P07 fallback in both safety cohorts. If P07 fails safety, leave the launcher unchanged.
Promote only a winner with passing safety checks; verify normal-launcher arguments, application API and clean shutdown. Preserve a rollback launcher. No benchmark or app server left running.

Three repetitions after one warmup per task per independent launch. ABBA. Fresh output256 except predefined short-answer safety output32. English code/prose only; cached512/2048 separate.
resources: Unchanged 34 GiB available before each launch, quiet host, normal pressure. One model-cache cleanup before this campaign if needed; no cache cleaning between benchmark arms. T3 and WiFiman preserved. No administrator prompt or VM restart.
failure_policy: Preserve failed and incomplete runs. Resource/parity/activation failures stop the campaign. No performance retry, partial pooling, criterion changes or automatic default promotion by the benchmark driver.
